correctness.summary: The comb is a proper locally finite R-tree. Its metric functionals are exactly the internals plus the unique-end Busemann function b=r-p. The endpoint formulas give the exact d-weak limit set and the L_n-n topology threshold.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Prior same-model search found no exact comb phase transition; related CAT(0) weak-topology literature concerns different notions.

value.summary: The result gives a sharp metric/non-Hausdorff threshold and a critical T1 hyperconnected example in a natural CAT(0) family.
